transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we lock the program, I need to hear from rights clearance and submissions staff — are there any outstanding issues with any of the competition titles, including 'After the Floodlights'? If everything is clear, we'll finalize the listing with the public screening and online trailer as currently drafted.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue with 'After the Floodlights.' I reviewed the executed music and archive license this morning. The license permits exactly one in-person public screening — that's fine. However, it does NOT allow us to publish any trailer or excerpt online, so the planned online trailer would violate the license. Additionally, we must use the exact credit 'Courtesy of Northline Archive.' I should also note I haven't added the license summary to the programming file yet, as the signed copy arrived in my separate clearance inbox.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a premiere-status issue with 'After the Floodlights.' I checked the filmmaker's signed premiere declaration against the festival database today and found that the film already had a public screening at the Harbor Documentary Week. This means it fails the competition's unpublished-premiere requirement. It cannot remain in competition — if we retain it at all, it would need to be offered as a single special screening instead. I haven't updated the submission record yet because the database correction queue is still open.
transcript.speaker: A3
